item.title: DMV introduces major changes to point system
item.description: BUFFALO, N.Y. (WIVB) -- Starting Monday, Feb. 16, several driving offenses will increase in the amount of points on a New York State driver's license. item.title: Buffalo State to deactivate several programs
item.description: BUFFALO, N.Y. (WIVB) -- Buffalo State University is deactivating several academic programs after a review found low enrollment and completion rates. The university said the changes impact one undergraduate program, two graduate programs and several minors and certificates, affecting less than one percent of current students. item.title: Governor Hochul signs Medical Aid in Dying Act
item.description: New York Governor Kathy Hochul signed the Medical in Dying Act into law on Friday, according to a statement from Assemblywoman Amy Paulin, which she also sponsored.

item.title: Intersection reopens to traffic after major water main break in Buffalo
item.description: BUFFALO, N.Y. (WIVB) -- The intersection of Hertel Avenue and Military Road reopened to traffic Friday night following a major water main break on Wednesday evening.
